description:
Updates the title of a specified page.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the page and its corresponding space. Permission to update pages in the space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the page to be updated. If you don't know the page ID, use Get Pages and filter the results

200.description: Returned if the requested page is successfully updated.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if:
- The provided page does not exist
- The user does not have permissions to view the page
- The user does not have the needed permissions to update a page in the space
- The user provides a parentId for a page that does not exist or they do not have permission to view
- There are no spaces associated with the given spaceId

409.description:
Returned if content approvals are enabled for the site and the page's space is configured to require approval before publishing.
Save the title change as a draft, then complete the approval workflow to publish.
